correctness.rationale: For every allowed n,m, the exact orthogonal projectors P and W give L=nP-2W with strictly positive nonzero eigenvalues n and n-2. From L^+ the simplex barycentric facet normals have Gram (L^+)^2, which yields four negative off-diagonal patterns and exact normalized cosines. Pair counting exhausts all simplex ridges, strict inequalities distinguish all present types and identify the deleted matching. Taylor expansions plus exact pair proportions prove the weak second-order binomial law, including vanishing-probability divergent exceptional ridges. The stand-alone exact rational checker validates all pairs for 77 configurations, without treating finite enumeration as proof.
